project_type: Full-stack monorepo: React+Vite+Tailwind v4 frontend + Express API + PostgreSQL (drizzle ORM)
build_system: pnpm workspaces with workspace:* references. Root build does typecheck then recursive build. Individual packages: pnpm --filter @workspace/creatools run build, pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
test_framework: No formal test framework found. Verification via typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and build success.
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm run typecheck to verify TypeScript compiles. 2. Run pnpm --filter @workspace/creatools run build to verify frontend builds. 3. Run pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build to verify API builds.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node 22 available. pnpm available. Docker may or may not be available for build validation.
contribution_requirements: Use pnpm only. Tailwind v4 with @import 'tailwindcss'. shadcn/ui components in artifacts/creatools/src/components/ui/. Wouter for routing. Express 5 for API.
key_patterns: Frontend: pages in artifacts/creatools/src/pages/, layout in components/layout/app-layout.tsx, CSS vars in index.css, contexts in context/. Backend: routes in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/, DB schema in lib/db/src/schema/. Admin page is massive single file (4974 lines). All colors use CSS custom properties (HSL) with inline styles for custom colors. Glassmorphism, neon glow effects already started. Uses lucide-react and react-icons for icons.
directory_structure: Root: infra/ (docker), artifacts/creatools/ (frontend SPA), artifacts/api-server/ (Express API), lib/db/ (drizzle schema), lib/api-spec/ (shared types), lib/api-zod/ (validators), scripts/ (utilities)
